### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
MacConkey agar is selective for Gram-negative bacteria due to the presence of crystal violet and bile salts, inhibiting the growth of Gram-positive bacteria. It is also differential, differentiating lactose fermenting (pink colonies) from non-lactose fermenting bacteria (colorless colonies), making it useful for identifying enteric bacteria.
